name: move
description: Walk the player with the pathfinder, with a time limit and a fallback for stuck paths.

routines.name: to
routines.description: Walk within `range` blocks of `position` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]) and stop. Gives up (and stops pathfinding) after `timeoutMs`. Returns where the player then stands.

routines.name: stop
routines.description: Stop pathfinding and clear the movement keys.

name: sense
description: Find blocks by name pattern and face a position, without changing anything.

routines.name: find
routines.description: Positions ({x,y,z}) of blocks matching `blocks` ('oak_log', '*_ore', or a list), nearest first. `radius` limits the search, `count` the number of results. Fails when no block type matches.

routines.name: look
routines.description: Turn the player's head to face `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]).

name: dig
description: Dig one block with the right tool; falling blocks that refill the hole are dug too.

routines.name: dig
routines.description: Dig the block at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), equipping the best tool and failing with the tools it needs when the inventory lacks them. Digs on while gravel or sand refills the position. Returns { block } — the last block dug, or null when the position was already clear.

name: place
description: Place one block from the inventory, digging out a different solid block first.

routines.name: place
routines.description: Place one block of `item` at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), walking close and digging out a different solid block first. Needs a solid neighbor to place against. Returns false if the block was already there, true otherwise.

name: inventory
description: Count and list what the inventory holds, equip an item, and toss items out.

routines.name: list
routines.description: Inventory totals by item name, e.g. { oak_log: 3, stick: 12 }.

routines.name: count
routines.description: How many items matching `items` ('stick', '*_log', or a list) the inventory holds.

routines.name: equip
routines.description: Hold or wear an item from the inventory. `slot`: 'hand' (default), 'off-hand', 'head', 'torso', 'legs', 'feet'.

routines.name: toss
routines.description: Toss `count` of `item` out of the inventory (a tossed stack lands about two blocks away).

name: craft
description: Craft items from the inventory at a table within reach.

routines.name: craft
routines.description: Craft at least `count` (default 1) more of `item` from the inventory. A recipe that needs a crafting table uses one within 4 blocks, and the call fails when there is none. Returns how many were made.

routines.name: table
routines.description: The position of a crafting table within 4 blocks, so a routine can stand next to it. Fails when there is none nearby.

name: items
description: Look up recipes, find the items lying on the ground, and rename an item at an anvil.

routines.name: recipes
routines.description: Up to 3 recipes for `item`: [{ makes, requiresTable, ingredients: { name: count } }]. Fails for an unknown item.

routines.name: drops
routines.description: Positions ({x,y,z}) of dropped item entities within `radius`, nearest first — what a dig has left to pick up.

routines.name: rename
routines.description: Rename the first stack of `item` in the inventory that does not already have `name` to `name` (1-50 characters; spaces are fine) at an anvil within reach (4.5 blocks; this never walks, so go there first, for example move.to). The cost is experience levels, usually 1 or more; an error names the cost and your level. When every stack of `item` already has `name`, this returns at once, spending nothing. Returns { item, name, count: how many were renamed, levelsSpent }.

name: furnace
description: Smelt at a furnace within reach: load fuel and input, wait, take the output.

routines.name: smelt
routines.description: Smelt `count` (default 1) of `item` (an input such as raw_iron, sand, cobblestone, beef, or a log) at the nearest furnace within 4.5 blocks, or at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), walking next to it first. Loads `fuel` (an item name) or else the first of charcoal, coal, planks, logs, sticks that the inventory holds in enough quantity; waits 10 s per item; takes the output. Fails with the missing item or fuel, or when no furnace is there. Returns { input, output, count, fuel, at }.

routines.name: take
routines.description: Collect the output of the furnace within 4.5 blocks, or at `at`, without waiting for it. Returns { item, count, smelting }: what was taken (item null when the slot was empty) and what the furnace is still smelting, or null.

name: container
description: Look into chests, barrels, and shulker boxes, and move items between them and the inventory.

routines.name: list
routines.description: What the chest, barrel, shulker box, hopper, dispenser, or dropper at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]) holds, walking next to it first. Returns { block, items: { name: count }, emptySlots }.

routines.name: deposit
routines.description: Put inventory items matching `items` ('cobblestone', '*_log', or a list) into the container at `at`, up to `count` in total (default all that match), as many as fit. Returns { deposited: { name: count }, total, full }; `full` is true when the container had no room for some of it. Fails when nothing in the inventory matches.

routines.name: withdraw
routines.description: Take items matching `items` ('iron_ingot', '*_planks', or a list) out of the container at `at` into the inventory, up to `count` in total (default all that match), as many as fit. Returns { withdrawn: { name: count }, total, full }; `full` is true when the inventory had no room for some of it. Fails when the container holds nothing that matches.

name: survival
description: Eat, sleep in a bed, wake up, and wear the best armor in the inventory.

routines.name: eat
routines.description: Eat `item`, or the best safe food in the inventory when omitted: the one that restores the most without overshooting the missing food points. Rotten flesh, spider eyes, pufferfish, poisonous potatoes, raw chicken, suspicious stew, chorus fruit, and golden apples are never picked on their own; name one to eat it. Fails when the food bar is full. Returns { item, food, saturation } after the meal.

routines.name: sleep
routines.description: Go to bed at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), or the nearest bed within 16 blocks, and sleep. Works at night (time of day 12541 to 23458) and in thunderstorms; fails with the reason otherwise, or when monsters are near the bed or the bed is occupied. Returns { sleeping, at } once asleep. Call `wake` or wait for morning to get up.

routines.name: wake
routines.description: Get out of bed. Fails when the player is not sleeping. Returns { sleeping } after waking.

routines.name: armor
routines.description: Wear the best armor the inventory holds in each slot, by material: leather, copper, golden, chainmail, iron, diamond, netherite (turtle helmets rank between golden and chainmail). Leaves better armor already worn, and an elytra, on. Returns { equipped: { slot: item }, wearing: { head, torso, legs, feet } }.

name: combat
description: Attack creatures with the best weapon, fight hostiles until none are near, and back away.

routines.name: attack
routines.description: Hit one creature until it dies. `target` is an entity id or a name ('zombie'; the nearest match, a player's username works too). Walks up to it, holds the best sword or axe from the inventory, and hits once per weapon cooldown. Gives up after `timeoutMs` (default 20000). Returns { target, killed, damageTaken, weapon }.

routines.name: fight
routines.description: Fight until no target is left within `radius` (default 16) or `timeoutMs` (default 60000) passes. Targets default to hostile mobs: the registry category 'Hostile mobs', which includes slimes, magma cubes, phantoms, and ghasts, minus endermen, zombified piglins, striders, and end crystals, which are no threat until provoked. `targets` ('zombie', '*_skeleton', or a list) names others, endermen included. Takes the nearest first, holds the best sword or axe from the inventory, skips a target it cannot kill in 20 seconds, and fails if the player dies. Creepers explode when close: retreat from them first. Returns { kills, damageTaken, weapon, remaining, timedOut }.

routines.name: retreat
routines.description: Walk away until more than `distance` (default 16) blocks from `from`: a position ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), an entity id, or a creature name. Without `from`, away from the nearest hostile mob within 32 blocks; fails when there is none. Gives up after `timeoutMs` (default 20000). Returns { position, distance } — where the player stopped and how far that is from `from`.

name: farm
description: Till soil, plant seeds, harvest ripe crops, and breed animals.

routines.name: till
routines.description: Hoe the dirt, grass_block, or dirt_path block at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]) into farmland, walking close and holding a hoe from the inventory. Digs out wild plants above it (grass, ferns, dead bush, flowers); fails when any other block is above, such as a torch, a sapling, or a crop. Farmland dries out and turns back to dirt unless water lies within 4 blocks. Returns { tilled, hydrated } — tilled is false when it already was farmland.

routines.name: plant
routines.description: Plant `seed` ('wheat_seeds', 'carrot', 'potato', 'beetroot_seeds', 'melon_seeds', 'pumpkin_seeds', 'torchflower_seeds', 'pitcher_pod', 'nether_wart', or the crop name such as 'wheat') on the farmland at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]); `at` may also be the empty block above the farmland. Nether wart needs soul_sand. Walks close and takes the seed from the inventory. Returns true when it planted, false when that crop already grows there.

routines.name: harvest
routines.description: Dig the ripe crops within `radius` (default 16), nearest first, collect the drops, and replant each (`replant`, default true) when the inventory has its seed. `crops` limits it to some of wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether_wart (a seed name matches too); default all. Stops after `timeoutMs` (default 120000). Returns { harvested, replanted, skipped, gained } — gained is the inventory change, e.g. { wheat: 3, wheat_seeds: 2 }.

routines.name: breed
routines.description: Feed the two adult `animal`s ('cow', 'sheep', 'pig', 'chicken', ...) nearest each other within `radius` (default 16) and wait up to `timeoutMs` (default 30000) for the baby. `food` defaults to what that animal eats and the inventory holds (cow, sheep, goat: wheat; pig: carrot, potato, beetroot; chicken: seeds). Fails when fewer than two adults are near, there is no food, or an animal refuses it (it bred in the last 5 minutes). Returns { fed, baby, babyId } — baby is false when none appeared in time.

name: bucket
description: Fill a bucket from a water or lava source, and pour it out.

routines.name: fill
routines.description: Fill an empty bucket from a `fluid` ('water' or 'lava') source: the one at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), or the nearest within `radius` (default 16). Walks within reach and tries up to 3 sources. Flowing fluid is not a source and cannot be taken. Returns { filled, at } — the bucket item now held, and the source's position.

routines.name: empty
routines.description: Pour a full bucket so its fluid source lands in the block at `at` ({x,y,z} or [x,y,z]), which must be air or a non-solid block next to a solid one. `fluid` ('water' or 'lava') picks the bucket; default whichever the inventory holds, water first. Walks within reach. Water evaporates in the Nether. Returns true when it poured, false when that source was already there.

name: gatherer
description: Collect resources: walk to matching blocks, dig them with the right tool, pick up the drops.

routines.name: gather
routines.description: Dig `count` blocks matching `blocks` ('*_log', 'stone', ['coal_ore','deepslate_coal_ore']) and pick up the drops, within `radius` (default 48). Equips the best tool and fails if a required tool is missing. `gained` is the inventory change, e.g. { oak_log: 4 }; `skipped` counts blocks it could not reach.

routines.name: collectDrops
routines.description: Walk over dropped items within `radius` (default 8) to pick them up. Returns how many drops it tried to reach.

name: crafter
description: Craft and smelt item chains from the inventory, finding or placing a crafting table or furnace when needed.

routines.name: make
routines.description: Make sure the inventory holds at least `count` (default 1) of `item`, crafting intermediate items (planks, sticks, tables) as needed and finding or placing a crafting table. An item that a furnace makes (iron_ingot, glass, stone, charcoal, cooked food) is smelted from the matching input the inventory holds, at a furnace within 32 blocks, else one placed from the inventory, else one crafted from 8 cobblestone; fuel is coal, charcoal, planks, or logs from the inventory. Fails with the missing raw material, which you must gather. Returns the count held.

name: builder
description: Place blocks and build structures from blueprints. Blueprints: { palette: { '#': 'oak_planks' }, layers: [layer, ...] }; layers go bottom to top, rows run along +z, characters along +x, '.' or space skips.

routines.name: materials
routines.description: Block counts the `blueprint` needs, e.g. { oak_planks: 24 }.

routines.name: build
routines.description: Build the `blueprint` with its first layer's first row's first character at `origin`. Skips blocks already correct, places bottom-up. Fails up front on missing materials unless `partial`. Returns { placed, alreadyCorrect, failed }.

routines.name: check
routines.description: Compare the world with the `blueprint` at `origin`: { correct, total, mismatches (first 20) }.

name: explorer
description: Explore new ground, summarize surroundings, remember named places, and climb out of holes to open sky.

routines.name: scan
routines.description: Summarize the area within `radius` (default 16): biome, uncommon blocks with counts and nearest positions (ores, logs, water, chests...), and nearby entities.

routines.name: explore
routines.description: Walk about `distance` blocks (default 48) toward the least-explored direction. Remembers visited 16x16 cells across calls. Gives up (and stops pathfinding) after `timeoutMs` (default 90000). Returns { from, to, reached, cellsVisited }.

routines.name: remember
routines.description: Save a named place at `at` (default: where the player stands) and return it. `kind` is one of chest, bed, farm, ore, base, portal, other (default other); `tags` and `note` describe it; `contents` maps item names to counts for a chest. Remembering a name again keeps the kind, tags, note, and contents you do not pass. Places survive runs and body restarts.

routines.name: places
routines.description: List saved places, nearest first. `kind` keeps one kind; `near` is the point distances are measured from (default: the player); `radius` drops places farther than that from `near` or in another dimension; `limit` (default 20) caps the list. Places in other dimensions come last without a `distance`. Returns places with name, kind, tags, note, contents, position, dimension, updatedAt, and distance.

routines.name: waypoints
routines.description: Every saved place by name as { x, y, z, dimension }. `places` lists them with their kind, tags, note, and contents.

routines.name: travel
routines.description: Walk to a saved place, stopping within `range` (default 2) blocks. Gives up after `timeoutMs` (default 120000). Returns where the player then stands.

routines.name: surface
routines.description: Climb to open sky by digging a staircase; use it when trapped underground or in a pit. Needs no blocks; slow without a pickaxe, so pass a long call timeout (e.g. --timeout 600000). Under water it checks the air supply: it does not dig what the air cannot cover and swims to air first. `maxSteps` (default 120) bounds the climb. Returns { surfaced, from, to, steps }.

name: social
description: Talk to, wait for, follow, and hand items to other players.

routines.name: say
routines.description: Send a public chat `message`. Other players and agents read chat.

routines.name: waitForChat
routines.description: Wait for the next chat message from another player. `from` (username), `match` (regex, case-insensitive), `timeoutMs` (default 60000).

routines.name: players
routines.description: Other online players: [{ username, distance, position }] (distance and position are null when out of view).

routines.name: follow
routines.description: Follow a `player` for `durationMs` (default 30000), staying within `distance` (default 2) blocks.

routines.name: give
routines.description: Walk to a `player` and toss them `count` (default 1) of `item`.
